k: İngilizce Tercüme - Rowad Tercüme Merkezi (sürüm 1.0.21) — QuranEnc.com kaynağından değiştirilmeden; şartlar: https://quranenc.com/tr/home/api/
t: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the Elephant[1]?
Did He not turn their scheme into a total loss[2]?
He sent against them swarms of birds,
pelting them with stones of baked clay,
dn: [1] The army of Abrahah al-Ashram was accompanied by a huge elephant who came with the intention of demolishing the Kaʿba.
